Meet Des

At Luxury Nails by Des, beauty meets luxury. As your one-stop beauty studio, I offer custom nail services, spa pedicures, and premium hair extensions in a private, welcoming space.

Every appointment is tailored to you, with a focus on quality, detail, and exceptional service. Whether you're maintaining your look or treating yourself to a full transformation, I'm committed to helping you leave feeling confident and beautiful.

The looks on her menu — classic French, milky Gel-X almonds, chrome coffins, Russian manicures, and the full spa pedicure ritual.

Before You Book

A few of Des's house rules, straight from her booking page — they keep every appointment on schedule.

  • Arrive with bare nails — unless you're booked for a fill, please come with clean, bare nails so your full appointment time goes to your new set.
  • Book your removal — if you have product on, add the Product Removal service when booking. Without it, there may not be enough time, and your service may need to be modified or rescheduled.
  • Custom sets are quoted individually — pricing is based on the design and level of detail. Send your inspiration photos before booking for a personalized quote.
  • Fills within 4 weeks — acrylic fills are for sets up to 31 days old with no more than one nail missing; older sets are booked as a new full set.
